data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Miscellaneous systemic drugs_

**Class:** Plasma expander (dextran 40) with rheological (anti-sludging) effects

## Mechanism of action
- Reduces blood viscosity and red-cell aggregation, coats platelets and endothelium → improves microcirculation

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Historically in livedoid vasculopathy, Raynaud phenomenon/digital ischaemia, frostbite, necrotic ulcers due to microvascular occlusion, pyoderma gangrenosum (adjunct)

## Dose & formulations
- 500 mL of 10% dextran 40 IV infusion daily for a few days (historic regimens)

## Adverse effects
- Anaphylactoid reactions (dextran-reactive antibodies), fluid overload, renal failure, bleeding tendency (platelet coating)

## Contraindications
- Heart failure, renal failure, bleeding disorders, dextran allergy

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid unless essential.

## Viva points
- Improves microcirculation — historical use in livedoid vasculopathy and digital ischaemia

_Sources: Khopkar (Miscellaneous agents — low molecular weight dextran). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
